Combine mod 212 and mod combined ion data frames.
```{r}
pR = inner_join(mods_212, mod_combined_ion, by = "Index")

pR_sites = pR %>%
  select(Organism, Index, Mod_Class, Modified_Residue, Modified_Position, 
         `Best Localization Probability`, Name, `Protein ID`, Gene, 
         `Peptide Sequence`, Stripped_Modified_Sequence, `Assigned Modifications`, 
         `M/Z`, Charge,
         ends_with("Spectral Count"), ends_with("Intensity.y"), 
         ends_with("Retention Time"), ends_with("Match Type"))

write_tsv(pR_sites, "pR_sites_Isabel.tsv")
```
